title: The warranty flag of a line follows its No Charge category
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks the Open API story of Internal Work Orders (SV-11833), which is built after the Open API refactoring and does not ship with the core release. Do not run it now. It can be tested once SV-11833 is released.

Preconditions

  • Use an Open API key for the test organization, the Open API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 No Charge under Warranty, line 2 No Charge under Goodwill and line 3 billable.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, category Warranty, in status Approved, with two lines.
custom_steps:
1. Send GET for work order 1 through the Open API.
  2. Send GET for work order 2 through the Open API.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Line 1 reads is_warranty true; line 2 and line 3 read false.

Step 2:

  • Both lines read is_warranty true.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.3 (12 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R22: “The per-line warranty flag that exists in the data and in the Open API (is_warranty; there is no toggle in the line dialog today and Print Work Order never printed it) becomes derived: true on a line that is No Charge with the category Warranty and on every line of a whole Warranty work order, false otherwise, never set by hand. Print Work Order gains the "No Charge · [category]" chip next to a no-charge line (S12-E8). Existing lines that carry the flag keep it as it is; they are not priced, marked or changed by the release.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
